verdict.rationale: cubic is a code-review tool with a web UI, a CLI and an AI chat, so cross-device task continuation is a fair question for it. However, no evidence documents starting a task or session on one device and resuming it from another device or browser. PR reviews and comments live on GitHub, but that is a host-platform capability rather than a cubic session-handoff feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser
